faq_heading: Homes near Elgin Park Secondary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the Elgin Park Secondary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the Elgin Park Secondary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names Elgin Park Secondary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near Elgin Park Secondary sell for?
faq.a: Within 2 km of the school, 214 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,915,000, townhomes $837,500, condos $1,022,450. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near Elgin Park Secondary?
faq.a: Within 2 km of Elgin Park Secondary the median was 34 days on the market, closing at 95.1% of the list price, with 4% of sales above the list price for the 214 homes within 2 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to Elgin Park Secondary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Chantrell Creek Elementary (0.6 km north-east), Laronde Elementary (1.3 km south-west) and Crescent Park Elementary (1.4 km west).

Elgin Park Secondary is a secondary school in Surrey (Surrey School District), at 13484 24 Ave. It teaches grades 8 to 12. Programs listed: Enhanced French (8-12).
Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions Elgin Park Secondary, followed by what homes within 2 km of the school sold for.
How the Elgin Park Secondary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names Elgin Park Secondary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 2 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.
What homes within 2 km of Elgin Park Secondary sold for
Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 214 homes sold within 2 km of Elgin Park Secondary: 165 houses, 24 townhomes and 16 condos. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,915,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of Elgin Park Secondary

9 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of Elgin Park Secondary in a straight line (8 elementary, 1 secondary; 0 independent). The closest is Chantrell Creek Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is H T Thrift Elementary, 2.9 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Semiahmoo Secondary (2.8 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Laronde Elementary (1.3 km). The nearest school teaching the same grades (8-12) is Semiahmoo Secondary, 2.8 km south-east of Elgin Park Secondary.
